simple.meaning: מְלוּנָה (mᵉlûwnâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a hut , a hammock.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מְלוּנָה (H4412) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 1:8, with occurrences in Isaiah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְלוּנָה (H4412) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְלוּנָה (H4412) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְלוּנָה (mᵉlûwnâh) / H4412 is traced through Isaiah 1:8, Isaiah 24:20 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
